dedupe_keys.name: nine months of daily lidar orthophotos and metocean data from the eroding soft cliff coast at happisburgh uk

description: Nine months of daily LiDAR, orthophotos and MetOcean data from the eroding soft cliff coast at Happisburgh, UK is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Catherine Pennington et al. The dynamic interaction between cliff, beach and shore-platform is key to assessing the sediment balance for coastal erosion risk assessments, but this is poorly understood. We present a dataset containing daily, 3D,colour LiDAR scans of a 450 m coastal section at Happisburgh, Norfolk, UK. Coverage: national (GB); published in 2024. Formats: CSV, Shapefile, MATLAB, TXT, Image. The only repository address found in the article is the code repository in Springer nature named in its Code Availability section; the data may be hosted elsewhere, as the Data Records section of the article states. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
